title: Proactive econ playbook: batching-first, adaptive caching & quantization roadmap
creator: Maya Hernandez
description: Initiative to create a reproducible, cross-team playbook that drives measurable unit-cost reductions (tokens/$) by prioritizing batching strategies, adaptive prefix/KV caching, and conservative quantization profiles. The playbook will include validated rollouts, guardrails for latency/quality SLOs, prebuilt eval suites, and automated dashboarding so product and infra teams can safely adopt changes at scale.
updates: 2025-01-20: Kickoff w/ Eng (Serving Runtime), Platform SRE, Research, and Design. Aligned on three pillars: batching-first configuration, adaptive KV/prefix caching, and Quantization Guardrails. Action: ENG to prototype batch-size autosuggestor (ENG-4198), Research to assemble eval prompts.

2025-01-28: Research delivered first QA prompt-set (2k prompts across short/long tails). Quick quality sweep shows <0.8% semantic regression for 8-bit quant on gpt-medium style models on representative prompts. Saved artifacts: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EconOps/PM-58321+Playbook+Artifacts

2025-01-31: Design reviewed console UX for a Playbook panel (rollout toggles, predicted cost/latency delta). Feedback: surface confidence intervals and link to per-route rollout history. Design spec: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/pm-58321-playbook-v1.pdf

2025-02-04: ENG-4021 prototype of adaptive prefix cache landed in branch; initial microbenchmarks: 22% token-cost reduction at 95th percentile for chat workloads with minimal p50 latency change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2784

2025-02-10: Product held risk-review w/ Security and SRE. Identified two risks: (1) cache poisoning from malformed system prompts, (2) unnoticed quality drift in long-tail prompts after quantization. Mitigations: input normalization filter, nightly eval runs + alerting. Follow-up tasks created for ENG/SRE.

2025-02-12: Draft playbook structure completed. Contains: decision tree for when to enable batching autosuggest, cache retention defaults and knob descriptions, quantization profiles with suggested models & eval thresholds, rollout recipe, and rollback criteria. Ready for early internal beta.
2025-02-12: Dashboard template created in Grafana (cost-per-1M-tokens, p50/p95 latency, quality-regression-rate). Preview: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/opt-playbook/cost-eval
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published in Confluence with step-by-step rollout recipe and decision heuristics
Automated eval suite integrated that runs nightly and reports quality delta per quantization profile
Batching autosuggestor prototype merged to staging (ENG-4198) and demoed to PM+SRE
Adaptive KV cache merged behind feature flag with dashboard showing cost/latency tradeoffs
Two internal services completed canary using the playbook with monitored rollback in place
next_steps: Run controlled canary 1: messaging-service using batching autosuggest (2/18 - 3/04). Metric owners: SLOs for p50/p95 and semantic-qa
Expand nightly eval prompts to include customer-provided prompt-sets (ask Solutions Eng to collect)
Finalize Console UI prototype and hand off to frontend EPD (DES-214 follow-up)
Implement cache input normalization and add unit tests (ENG-4021 follow-up)
Create runbook for rollback and quality alert escalation with SRE
